reviewNotes: GPT-6 AI editorial review of 26 original low-typing questions. Reviewed complete German sentences, each distractor, keys, bilingual explanations and distinct contexts. Thirteen sources authored, four deferred for word-class/sense ambiguity, three mapped to existing objectives (mittlerweile/inzwischen; noch mal/nochmal). Nochmals separately assesses formal reiteration, not the existing spoken repetition request. Inherited nachher time restriction corrected. No inherited literary examples copied. CEFR source levels unverified; structural CI is not independent editorial review, rights clearance, certification or transfer evidence. All target reviews pending and publicationApproved=false. Follow-up editorial correction: jeweils distribution question explicitly says genau zwei, excluding the potentially defensible ungefähr alternative.
